choices.text: Nothing: a bar model is only a rough sketch
The colours of the bars are different
The unit boxes are not all the same length, so the bars are not to scale

questions.explanation: The trap is: Drawing unit boxes in any lengths, guessing the sizes. The bar is treated as a rough sketch rather than a scale model. Every unit box must be exactly the same length: two units is exactly twice one unit.
questions.misconception: Drawing unit boxes in any lengths, guessing the sizes.
questions.prompt: Sam draws a bar model for 1 unit and 2 units. He draws the unit boxes in any lengths he likes, guessing the sizes, so his 2-unit bar is not twice his 1-unit bar. What is wrong with Sam's model?

questions.explanation: Scene s1: line the two bars up - Mia has 2 unit boxes and Ben has 3 unit boxes of the same length, so Ben has 3 - 2 = 1 more unit.
questions.prompt: Mia has 2 units and Ben has 3 units. Every unit box is drawn the same length. How many more units does Ben have than Mia?

questions.explanation: Scene s2: the before bar shows 3 units, one unit moves away along the arrow, and the after bar shows 2 units.
questions.prompt: Mia has 3 units. She gives 1 unit away to her sister. Draw a before-and-after model in your head: how many units does Mia have left?

questions.explanation: Scene s3: the whole bar is 7 units, so the girls are 7 - 3 = 4 units, and the difference between the parts is diff = 4 - 3 = 1 unit.
questions.prompt: A class bar is split into 7 equal units. 3 units are boys and the rest are girls. How many units are girls, and what is the difference between the girls' units and the boys' units?

choices.text: A 2-unit bar drawn a little bit longer than the 1-unit bar
A 2-unit bar drawn three times as long as the 1-unit bar
A 2-unit bar made of two unit boxes, each exactly the same length as the 1-unit bar

questions.explanation: Scene s4: the correct bars have matching unit boxes, so the 2-unit bar is exactly twice the 1-unit bar: 2 units = 2 x 1 unit.
questions.prompt: Which drawing is a correct bar model for 1 unit and 2 units?
